cc:Work.dc:title: Two B300 GPUs · Qwen3.8-Flash-Next BF16
cc:Work.dc:description: Stock AR, stock MTP3 and AX Engine MTP7 at concurrency 1, 4 and 16 for code, math and chat. MTP7 leads on code and math; stock MTP3 leads on chat.
